description: This file contains functions, types, and state management logic for handling cron jobs within a UI application, including loading, editing, validating, and executing cron jobs.

methods.name: supportsAnnounceDelivery
methods.description: Checks if the cron form supports announce delivery based on session target and payload kind.

methods.name: normalizeCronFormState
methods.description: Adjusts the cron form state, especially delivery mode, based on support conditions.

methods.name: validateCronForm
methods.description: Validates the cron form fields and returns errors if any.

methods.name: hasCronFormErrors
methods.description: Checks if there are any validation errors in the cron form.

methods.name: loadCronStatus
methods.description: Fetches the current cron status from the server.

methods.name: loadCronModelSuggestions
methods.description: Loads suggested models for cron payloads.

methods.name: loadCronJobs
methods.description: Loads the list of cron jobs.

methods.name: loadCronJobsPage
methods.description: Loads a page of cron jobs with optional append.

methods.name: loadMoreCronJobs
methods.description: Loads additional cron jobs for pagination.

methods.name: reloadCronJobs
methods.description: Reloads the list of cron jobs.

methods.name: updateCronJobsFilter
methods.description: Updates filters applied to the cron jobs list.

methods.name: getVisibleCronJobs
methods.description: Returns cron jobs filtered by schedule kind and last status.

methods.name: startCronEdit
methods.description: Begins editing a specific cron job.

methods.name: buildCloneName
methods.description: Generates a unique name for cloned cron jobs.

methods.name: startCronClone
methods.description: Prepares the form for cloning an existing cron job.

methods.name: cancelCronEdit
methods.description: Cancels editing or cloning a cron job and resets form.

methods.name: buildCronSchedule
methods.description: Constructs a cron schedule object from form data.

methods.name: buildCronPayload
methods.description: Builds the payload object for a cron job based on form data.

methods.name: buildFailureAlert
methods.description: Creates a failure alert configuration from form data.

methods.name: addCronJob
methods.description: Adds a new cron job or updates an existing one.

methods.name: toggleCronJob
methods.description: Enables or disables a cron job.

methods.name: runCronJob
methods.description: Triggers execution of a cron job.

methods.name: removeCronJob
methods.description: Removes a cron job.

methods.name: loadCronRuns
methods.description: Loads execution logs for a specific cron job.

methods.name: loadMoreCronRuns
methods.description: Loads additional cron run logs for pagination.

methods.name: updateCronRunsFilter
methods.description: Updates filters for viewing cron run logs.
